note: Two-stage roll on dish completion. Mitts do NOT affect this (mitts are lever-only). Luck Potions affect stage 2 only.

stage1_willItMutate.note: Flat, not luck-influenced. 80% of dishes stay plain.

stage2_whichMutation.formula: weight = 1 / priceMultiplier (from mutations.json), normalized to sum to 100%
stage2_whichMutation.note: Reuses the existing price-multiplier table instead of a separate hand-picked curve - rarer/pricier mutations are naturally rarer to land.
stage2_whichMutation.luckPotionEffect: Adds the same per-rank bonus already defined in luck.json's luckPotionRedBonus (Luck I-V: +1/2/3/5/7%) directly onto Void's share, taken proportionally from the other 9 mutations. Same mechanism as lever luck, different table.
